name: adspirer-retail-ads
description: Amazon & Walmart retail advertising. Analyze ad performance, track ACoS and ROAS, research keywords, and create and optimize campaigns with your approval.

skills.name: adspirer-retail-ads-ad-creative
skills.description: Develop Amazon and Walmart advertising copy and asset plans using product evidence, platform formats and user-approved uploads or changes.

skills.name: adspirer-retail-ads-amazon
skills.description: Manage Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display using the Retail endpoint, with profile-aware research, reporting and approved changes.

skills.name: adspirer-retail-ads-campaign-launch
skills.description: Plan and build paused Amazon and Walmart advertising campaigns with approved products, targeting, budgets and verified resources.

skills.name: adspirer-retail-ads-keyword-research
skills.description: Research retail keywords, ASINs, shopper demand, competitive products and targeting opportunities for Amazon and Walmart.

skills.name: adspirer-retail-ads-optimization
skills.description: Find wasted retail ad spend and propose Amazon or Walmart bid, targeting and budget improvements with explicit approval and readback.

skills.name: adspirer-retail-ads-performance
skills.description: Review Amazon and Walmart spend, attributed sales, ACoS, ROAS, item performance and budget pacing without changing campaigns.

skills.name: adspirer-retail-ads-product-help
skills.description: Answer Adspirer product, pricing, connection, quota and troubleshooting questions from current documentation, scoped to Amazon and Walmart.

skills.name: adspirer-retail-ads-setup
skills.description: Connect Amazon Ads and Walmart Connect accounts and optionally establish an approved retail brand workspace.

skills.name: adspirer-retail-ads-strategy
skills.description: Coordinate Amazon and Walmart retail-media planning, research, reporting, campaign creation and approved optimization.

skills.name: adspirer-retail-ads-tools
skills.description: Discover and call Amazon Ads and Walmart Connect tools through Adspirer Retail Ads. Use before retail tool calls to select the correct router and live schema.

skills.name: adspirer-retail-ads-walmart
skills.description: Manage Walmart Connect advertising, keyword and item performance, catalog insights, placements and approved campaign or asset changes.

subagents.name: adspirer-retail-advertising-agent
subagents.description: Coordinate Amazon and Walmart retail-media research, reporting, paused campaign builds and approved optimization with the Retail Ads skills.

rules.name: use-adspirer-retail-ads
rules.description: Use Adspirer Retail Ads for Amazon and Walmart advertising requests with live discovery and explicit approval before writes.
